subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this opt-in durable wake/replay architecture in core for the 2026.7.1 line, contingent on the prerequisite foundation landing first?
rationale: The patch is technically credible, but it adds substantial persistent schema, protocol, environment, session-state, and delivery semantics that cannot be accepted solely from implementation quality or CI.

options.title: Sponsor the staged stack
options.body: Approve the core direction, land the prerequisite foundation first, then refresh this PR against that base and retain downstream live-delivery gates before enablement.

options.title: Hold for cumulative proof
options.body: Keep the stack open but defer release inclusion until the final handoff PR demonstrates the complete restart-to-visible-delivery flow.

options.title: Decline the core direction
options.body: Close or narrow the durable stack if restart recovery should remain with existing task, queue, session, or plugin-specific owners.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged stack
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction, land the prerequisite foundation first, then refresh this PR against that base and retain downstream live-delivery gates before enablement.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans core architecture, compatibility, persistent storage, and release inclusion rather than a narrow code-owner repair.
